name: IPTC数据验证
description: 验证 IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) 元数据 fields for 真实性 markers, digital source type classification, and AI tool signatures in professional photo workflows.
mechanism:
The IPTC verification examines professional 元数据 layers:

1. **DigitalSourceType Classification**: 检查 ISO 12639 DigitalSourceType field for non-photographic indicators 如 'trainedAlgorithmicMedia', 'algorithmicMedia', 'virtualRecording', or 'compositeSynthetic'.

2. **Authenticity Field Count**: Counts professional IPTC fields (credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords). High field count indicates professional photographic workflow.

3. **AI Reference Detection**: Scans IPTC values for references to AI tools (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, etc.) in source, credit, and software fields.

4. **Workflow Validation**: Validates that IPTC 元数据 follows professional photography conventions — wire services, stock agencies, and newsrooms embed rich IPTC data.
parameters:
IPTC 真实性 fields: credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords, instructions, category
DigitalSourceType values: photographicImage, negativeFilm, positiveFilm, trainedAlgorithmicMedia, algorithmicMedia, virtualRecording
ISO 12639 classifications
accuracy: 高 - 85%+ for professional news/stock photos with IPTC data. Limited for consumer photos 其 rarely include IPTC.
useCase: Professional photo verification: validates images from news agencies, stock photo services, and professional photographers. The presence of comprehensive IPTC 元数据 strongly indicates professional origin.
strengths:
• DigitalSourceType存在时提供明确AI声明
• 专业照片拥有AI无法复制的丰富IPTC数据
• 所有主要通讯社使用的行业标准
• 从IPTC源字段识别特定AI工具
• DigitalSourceType零误报
limitations:
• 消费者照片很少包含IPTC数据
• IPTC字段可以手动伪造
• 许多AI服务未设置DigitalSourceType
• 社交媒体删除IPTC元数据
• IPTC缺失不表示AI生成

references.title: ISO 12639:2004 — Graphic technology — Prepress digital data exchange (DigitalSourceType)
